principles: Product/task UI (forms, checkout, pricing, auth) is sans-first — one sans family or sans + mono for digits
Editorial serif belongs on spectacle surfaces (404, hero type-as-image) — not on form labels or checkout headlines
Distinctive sans (Source Sans 3, IBM Plex Sans, Söhne-style grotesk) beats Inter/Geist template stacks
Hierarchy through weight, size, and tabular nums — not swapping to serif for 'premium feel'
sansFirstKeywords: payment|checkout|card form|billing form|credit card|pay with card|payment card

auth.direction: Sans-first task UI — Source Sans 3, IBM Plex Sans, or similar distinctive sans (not Inter/Geist). Headline at product scale (1.25–1.75rem semibold), not magazine serif display. Mono optional for OTP digits only.
avoid: Fraunces or Instrument Serif on form headline
Serif on field labels or helper text

pricing.direction: Sans-first plan UI — tier names and price in one sans stack. Large price via size/weight + tabular nums, not serif display. NumberFlow on toggle.
avoid: Serif tier titles on SaaS pricing cards
Editorial display headline above a billing toggle

landing.direction: Match product job — bento/marketing may use display contrast, but default sans body + sans or grotesk display unless concept is type-as-image.
pairings: Single sans family with weight scale
avoid: Fraunces on every card title by default
Serif headline + sans form mismatch without intent

hero.direction: Display voice allowed — condensed grotesk, stretched sans, stencil, or intentional serif when type IS the visual. Still not Inter + purple blob.
avoid: Syne / Space Grotesk / DM Sans template pairing

404.direction: Type-as-image courage — serif, grotesk, or monospace display OK when concept demands it. One voice, committed scale.

productRules.match: payment|checkout|card form|billing form|credit card|pay with card|payment card
productRules.direction: Sans-first checkout — form, headline, and card preview all sans. Product-scale title, tabular card number. No editorial serif headline.

defaultCreative: Choose type for product voice — sans-first for task UI; display serif only when type IS the concept (404/hero).
